title: pisum sativum subsp. syriacum
intro: Pisum sativum subsp. syriacum, commonly known as Syrian garden pea, is a subspecies of the pea plant, specifically referring to a wild pea species native to the Middle East. This plant is rich in nutrients and offers various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Pisum sativum subsp. syriacum include its ability to protect against oxidative stress, improve cardiovascular health, and support digestive health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
